title: What is MASS? Meet the Thai super-app that does it all in one place
metaDescription: Get to know MASS, the Thai super-app that combines food delivery, ride-hailing, parcel delivery and shopping in one app, with every function that makes daily life easier.
excerpt: Every service Thais use daily — food, transport, delivery and shopping — in one app. See how MASS makes your everyday life more convenient.
coverAlt: The many services of the MASS super-app
keywords: what is MASS, super app, Thai super app, food delivery ride app
intro: In an era where everything needs to be fast and convenient, having a single app that meets all your daily needs has become essential. MASS is the Thai super-app that brings the core services together — food delivery, transport, parcel delivery, and shopping — so you can handle everything in one place.

sections.h: What is a super-app, and why does it suit Thais?
sections.body: A super-app is an application that combines many services in one place. Instead of downloading a separate app for each need, users can do everything from a single app — saving space on their device, managing accounts and payments easily, and enjoying a seamless experience.
MASS is designed to cover the daily routines of Thais, with these core services:
bullets: MASS Food — order food delivery from your favourite restaurants to your home
MASS Ride — book bikes, cars and taxis
MASS Messenger — send parcels and documents express, same day
MASS Mart — buy fresh groceries and essentials from nearby supermarkets

sections.body: Beyond the breadth of services, MASS cares about safety, transparent pricing, and looking after users, riders, and merchant partners alike. As a Thai brand, MASS truly understands the behaviour and needs of Thai people, ready to be an important helper in your daily life.

title: 5 tips to order food delivery that's great value and tastes like dine-in
metaDescription: Five tips to order food delivery that's delicious, fresh and best value — from choosing the menu and timing your order to using promotions wisely.
excerpt: Ordering food delivery that tastes like dine-in and offers the best value isn't hard — here are 5 simple tips we've gathered for you.
coverAlt: Thai food beautifully plated and ready to serve
keywords: food delivery tips, order food delivery, order food value
intro: Getting both taste and value from food delivery is easier than you'd think. This article gathers 5 simple techniques to make every delivery meal better.

sections.body: Some foods travel better — rice-and-curry, stir-fries and fried items keep their flavour well after delivery. For food that must be piping hot or extra crispy, choose a nearby restaurant so it reaches you as fast as possible.

sections.h: 2. Order ahead to avoid rush hours
sections.body: Lunch and dinner are peak order times. Ordering a little ahead or avoiding peak hours helps your food arrive faster and hotter, fresher than before.
Regularly check new-customer promotions, delivery-fee discounts, or special-meal deals in the MASS app. Combining orders with others at home also helps you reach minimums and save on delivery.
Note address landmarks, special requests such as spice level or no coriander, and a clear contact number — this helps both the restaurant and the rider serve you accurately and quickly.

sections.h: 5. Rate and review after you receive your food
sections.body: Rating restaurants and riders helps maintain service standards and informs other users' decisions, and it also helps the system recommend restaurants that match your taste.

title: Travel safely with MASS Ride: safety features you should know
metaDescription: Learn about MASS Ride's safety features — from driver identity verification and route sharing to the SOS button and trip protection — so every trip gives you peace of mind.
excerpt: Safety is the heart of every trip. See what features MASS Ride offers to look after you and your family on every ride.
coverAlt: A MASS Ride vehicle that prioritises safety
keywords: ride safety, MASS Ride safe, safety features
intro: Safety is the most important thing when travelling, so MASS Ride has developed several features to look after passengers on every trip. Let's look at what helps you and your family feel at ease.

sections.body: Every MASS Ride driver must pass a background check and identity verification before providing service, so you can be confident the person picking you up is the real registered driver, with vehicle and plate details matching the app.
During your trip, you can share your live location and route with family or trusted friends, adding peace of mind — especially for night trips or unfamiliar routes.
If something unexpected happens, the in-app emergency (SOS) button lets you request help immediately, 24/7 — another layer of safety that MASS provides.
Every MASS Ride trip comes with protection to look after passengers, helping you travel with greater peace of mind.

title: Want extra income? Everything to know before becoming a MASS rider
metaDescription: A guide for those interested in becoming a MASS rider — from qualifications and the application process to the benefits of working independently with income.
excerpt: Want flexible extra income? Here's everything to know before becoming a MASS rider — the benefits, qualifications, and how to apply.
keywords: become a rider, MASS rider, rider job, extra income
intro: Being a food and parcel delivery rider is a choice for those who want freedom in their work and flexible income. If you're interested in becoming a MASS rider, this article gathers everything you should know.

sections.h: Benefits of being a MASS rider
sections.body: Being a MASS rider gives you the flexibility to choose your own working hours, suitable for both primary and supplementary income, with these appealing benefits:
bullets: Choose your working hours freely, at your convenience
A steady stream of jobs from a large user base

sections.body: Generally, applicants should be of the legal age required, have a ready-to-use vehicle, a valid driver's license, and a smartphone to use the rider app. Detailed qualifications may vary by service type and area.

Just fill in the online application with the required information and documents. Our team will contact you to confirm and arrange usage training, and then you're ready to start accepting jobs and earning with MASS right away.

title: Online shops take note: deliver to customers same-day with MASS Messenger
metaDescription: MASS Messenger helps online shops deliver products to customers within a day, creating a great impression, boosting sales and repeat purchases, with transparent tracking.
excerpt: Delivery speed is the heart of selling online. See how MASS Messenger helps shops deliver to customers the same day.
coverAlt: Express parcel delivery service for online shops
keywords: online shop delivery, same day delivery, MASS Messenger business
intro: In the world of online selling, delivery speed is one of the key factors that impress customers and bring them back. MASS Messenger is a tool that helps elevate online shops' delivery service.

sections.body: Getting products to customers within a day sets you apart from competitors. Customers don't wait several days, increasing the chance of closing the sale and creating a great first impression — especially for products customers need urgently.
Both shop and customer can track delivery status in real time, reducing questions and parcel concerns, making after-sales service smooth and building trust in your brand.
With transparent delivery fees calculated by distance, shops can plan delivery costs precisely while offering customers a fast delivery option — a worthwhile investment in the long run.
